item.title: The Seasons Are Wrong
item.description:
📝 Culturally, summer and winter should represent opposite extremes, while spring and fall should represent the transitions between them. Instead of summer starting on the summer solstice, summer will start halfway between the spring equinox and the summer solstice (~May 7). This puts summer solstice in the middle of the summer, instead of the start of summer.
🔗 Read more: https://kentwalters.com/posts/seasons/
